title: Creating Predictable Weekly Routines
learningGoal: Build predictable weekly routines that support stability and reduce stress.
microLesson: Weekly routines help children feel secure and reduce emotional overload. Predictability supports recovery after DFV.
activity: Create a weekly routine with 3–5 anchor points.

title: Supporting Children Through Change
learningGoal: Help children manage transitions and changes safely.
microLesson: Children often struggle with transitions after DFV. Preparing them with clear steps and reassurance reduces anxiety.
activity: Identify one upcoming change and create a preparation plan.

title: Strengthening Emotional Awareness
learningGoal: Increase emotional awareness for both caregiver and child.
microLesson: Emotional awareness helps prevent escalation and supports healthy communication. Naming emotions reduces overwhelm.
activity: Complete an emotion‑naming exercise for yourself and your child.

title: Positive Behaviour Coaching
learningGoal: Use positive coaching to guide behaviour and build confidence.
microLesson: Positive coaching focuses on modelling, encouragement, and clear expectations rather than punishment.
activity: Write three positive coaching statements you can use this week.

title: Reducing Household Tension
learningGoal: Identify and reduce sources of tension in the home.
microLesson: Tension builds from stress, noise, conflict, and unpredictable routines. Small changes can significantly improve emotional safety.
activity: Identify one tension source and create a reduction plan.

title: Caregiver Self‑Regulation
learningGoal: Strengthen self‑regulation skills to support calm parenting.
microLesson: Caregiver regulation directly affects child behaviour. Techniques include grounding, breathing, and planned breaks.
activity: Write a short self‑regulation plan for stressful moments.

title: Weekly Reflection and Progress Tracking
learningGoal: Reflect on weekly progress and identify next steps.
microLesson: Reflection helps track improvements in routines, emotional safety, and parenting confidence.
activity: Write a 150‑word reflection on progress and challenges.
